sources.snippet: MOSS-Audio is an open-source audio understanding model from MOSI.AI, the OpenMOSS team, and Shanghai Innovation Institute. It performs unified modeling over complex real-world audio, supporting speech understanding, environmental sound understanding, music understanding, audio captioning, time-aware QA, and complex reasoning.
